international.title: Iowa lead detonation: US army to blow up bomb-making chemicals despite concerns - live updates
international.summary: The army plans to detonate of 68 barrels containing nearly 9,500lbs of lead azide despite public concern about potential health and environmental effects Sign up for the Breaking News US email The US army has released new maps showing the projected path of a toxic lead dust plume from the planned detonation of 68 barrels – five tons – of lead axide at an Iowa ammunition dump. Projections show a plume moving south-west of the Iowa army ammunition plant in Middletown, stretching through a south-eastern portion of the state before extending into northern Missouri.
